items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: of course Jess, my cousin played the guitar along with them... They had piano, drums, guitar of course with Jess in there.

ctx.x: Can you tell us something a little bit more about him? He worked in Pittsburgh?

Yeah, well he was younger -- Jess was a couple years younger than I was and he had started out quite early to dance and he played the guitar, too. I think on some occasions he played with Harry. And when Harry would work in clubs I think Jess would probably perform on the job.

See, I couldn't get into the clubs because my voice was too soft and the clubs that Harry worked in, this was before microphones and I just couldn't be heard and the singers he had there was these robust women who could sing in the middle…
